row: Dr. Chau is an award-winning, nationally recognized veterinarian, and accomplished author on pet health.  Her latest article has been recommended by the national association of veterinarians, as well as the state associations of veterinarians for Texas, Oregon, Delaware, and hundreds of animal hospitals and perhaps up to a quarter-million readers.  Dr. Chau is owner of Family Veterinary Hospital in Chantilly, VA as well as Middleburg Animal Hospital in Middleburg, Virginia.  Read about Dr. Chau's philosophy here: http://loudounwomanmagazine.com/2013/11/letter-to-a-pet-owning-nation/  and enjoy our dozens of videos showing pet-owners the latest in pet treatments, including acupuncture, endoscopy, laser therapy etc.
